en: The postcard features a historic city street scene with several multistory buildings lining both sides. The street is bustling with people in period clothing, suggesting an early 20th-century European setting. Prominent signage is visible, advertising Theodor Lüer's linen and laundry factory. The buildings' facades display extensive German text, and businesses are identified as 'Wäschefabrik,' 'Leinen-Handlung,' and 'Engros Lager für Leinen u. Wäsche Stoffen.' The street name 'Bahnhofstrasse' and 'Postamt' (post office) are identified at the bottom of the postcard. The overall illustration style is typical of late 19th to early 20th century German postcards.
